final_message:
Done. `python3 -m pytest -q` passes: 6 passed.

Two bugs fixed in `lrucache/cache.py`:

- `get` never called `move_to_end`, so reads didn't count as "use" and recently-read entries could be evicted — added `self._data.move_to_end(key)` on a hit (`cache.py:31`).
- `put` ran the capacity check even when the key already existed, so updating a key in a full cache wrongly evicted the LRU entry — the eviction now only happens for new keys (`cache.py:34`).

`SOLUTION.md` documents both root causes.
